# ClearUX

> AI-powered UX audits: 96 checkpoints, 6 modules. Severity-ranked, evidence-backed, shippable fixes. First audit free.

## What ClearUX does

ClearUX crawls any website and uses AI to evaluate its user experience across 96 checkpoints in 24 categories grouped into 6 modules. It generates detailed audit reports with an overall score (0-100), module breakdowns, and prioritised findings with severity levels (critical, high, medium, low). Reports include evidence-based findings, actionable recommendations, and downloadable PDF and Word exports.

ClearUX also audits brand identity materials and design files, making it a 360-degree UX platform.

## The 6 modules (24 categories, 96 checkpoints)

1. Foundation: The structural and technical baseline a great experience is built on — first impressions, messaging clarity, navigation flow, conversion paths
2. Human Experience: How the product feels to use — clarity, flow, cognitive load, wellbeing, ethical UX, dark pattern detection
3. Inclusive Design: Accessibility and equity for every user — WCAG compliance, mobile responsiveness, keyboard navigation, universal access
4. Future Readiness: AI discoverability and how the product holds up as discovery shifts — agent navigation, structured data, llms.txt
5. Brand Consistency: Whether what users see matches what the brand promises — visual identity, tone, messaging alignment
6. SEO Structure: Whether the product is findable, legible, and ranked the way it deserves — metadata, headings, canonical tags

## Key features

- 96-checkpoint AI-powered UX analysis across 6 modules
- Multi-model AI benchmarking (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini)
- AI visibility score — how AI models perceive and describe your site
- Industry benchmarking with percentile ranking
- Predictive recommendations with impact scoring
- Results delivered in under 10 minutes
- Severity-ranked findings with evidence and recommendations
- Score tracking across re-audits to measure improvement
- Focused re-audits: choose which modules to re-audit
- Shareable read-only report links (no account needed for viewers)
- PDF and Word report downloads
- Multi-language reports (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese)
- First audit free, no credit card required

## Pricing

### Subscriptions
- Starter: $29/month (3 audits/month, unlimited re-audits)
- Pro: $59/month (10 audits/month, white-label reports)
- Agency: $149/month (30 audits/month, white-label, dedicated support)
- Annual billing: save up to 20%

### Credit packs (never expire)
- Starter: $39 for 3 audits ($13 each)
- Growth: $99 for 10 audits ($9.90 each)
- Scale: $249 for 30 audits ($8.30 each, white-label included)

### Free tier
- First audit free, no credit card required

## Who it is for

- Product teams evaluating their own products
- UX designers and researchers conducting audits
- Agencies auditing client websites
- Founders and marketers optimising conversion
- Accessibility teams checking WCAG compliance
